examples.summary: The band as the customers page places it: the overline and headline over a nine-mark logo wall, with one signed quote from Zoop in the aside and a link out to its case study. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no logos and no quote renders only its title.

examples.name: Quote band
examples.summary: `kind="quote"` sets the quote alone as a full-width band, with no logos: the design sample's QuoteBand. `quote-kind="highlight"` gives it the featured register with the mark beside the text.
